scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, source/report, bar-anchored cue and visual review; not aural review.

defects.finding: Targeted inspection after the Important Event finding confirms that this page also lacks the source-encoded binary repeat signs. Both spacer-voice repeat-volta-count-1 wrappers are suppressed by modern engraving, although the performed map repeats 1–8 and 9–22.
defects.requiredFix: Restore the original repeat boundaries with a guarded notation-only compatibility repair: closing first-strain repeat after 8, second-strain start at 9 and closing repeat after 22 (plus the initial delimiter where appropriate). Preserve all 444 performed notes, both source MIDI tracks, 22 written bar identities, four resolving listen pointers and exact 1–8 twice / 9–22 twice traversal. Re-publish and document the legacy visibility repair; inspect the actual restored marks, not only index.json coverage.

resolution.finding: The listening owner qualified the bar-15 return as beginning on D5 rather than the original B4, with the remaining top line following the opening, and made the intro consistent. That initial caller finding is resolved; the subsequently discovered repeat-visibility defect remains separate.

report.finding: The completed report matches the numerical gates, performed binary repeats, corrected quiet final attack, source attribution and one-page bar coverage. It must additionally record restoration of the suppressed printed repeat signs.

barMap.finding: All 444 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and occurrence times strictly increase. Actual glyph/index sets are exactly 1–22; the single printed page was inspected. Cue 1/2 resolves to 17.925 s; transition anchors 9/1, 15/1 and 9/2 resolve to 36.135, 53.460 and 72.413 s respectively. The corrected bar-15 narrative now agrees with the source melody.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified across the opening, repeat returns, middle, both detector-worst regions and corrected quiet final G4 near 109.08 s. Final written durations are not measured key releases.

version.finding: Original piano scoring; bars 1–8 twice, then 9–22 twice. The written return at 15 is retained rather than replaced with a literal copy of 1–8. Timing/order are coherent, but missing printed repeat signs currently prevent notation acceptance. Two source-staff aggregates are not separately recovered performed voices.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the identified source edition is not claimed as Donald Betts’s performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The alignment and source-voice interpretation remain provisional.
